scope: Read-only audit of the first jo9_chaotic removal tier in tmp/bugreports-20261102/current-decoded.qsps; no game, translation, save, engine, or browser changes.
policy: Completely negative traits first; mixed traits only when none remain. Perversion preference, courage=1, and nymphomania=2 are user-confirmed protected traits outside this first-tier audit.
priorityMeaning: All rows are currently first-tier candidates. Source order is not removal order: the routine randomly selects among present first-tier candidates. Activity and legacy work_ethic branches are mutually exclusive.
boundaryNotes: A trait name, flavor description, or generic usefulness of fear/guilt does not prove a beneficial mechanical trait effect.
No beneficial meekness=-1 effect was found among its actual references; do not mark free spirit mixed merely from its name.

Innate mute flavor text claims advantages, but actual jo9_voice_trait references only gate speech/rhetoric actions, alter narration, and implement compatibility; prevention of conspiracy or screams was not found.

Legacy incompatible work_ethic=-1 is audited separately from the merged activity sign. An independent nonstandard passion_comfort value can still have effects but is not removed when only work_ethic is cleared.

Sport-affinity=-1 skips automatic exercise and therefore skips that exercise's three-calorie cost. This is an indirect resource side effect, not a dedicated positive trait modifier; user policy can decide whether that alone warrants mixed classification.
